asr.full_text: Friends, Samsung has launched its brand new phone in India And here I have the Samsung Galaxy S9 Plus So keep watching this video I will talk to you about this phone Let's do its unboxing and give you the in-box contents And how is this Samsung Galaxy S9 Plus Hello friends, my name is Gaurav You are watching Technical Guruji Let's start Music So friends, here we have the box of Samsung's latest flagship phone, Galaxy S9 Plus Its storage is 64GB and its color is Coral Blue There are some more details mentioned behind the box Where you can get some interesting specifications about this phone The sticker here tells us that this phone is made in India and the price is Rs.70,000 By the way, its real price is Rs.64,900 Now let's not waste much time here, let will just open the box and remove the top sleeve. Before the seal, we get a warning written here that it's an Indian SIM card only. After opening the box, you get a bunch of paper guides on top. Where you will get full knowledge about this phone. Along with that, we have a SIM ejector tool and a basic case. It's placed right below it. We will place this phone on down And keep it side view So first of all, you will get a USB connector Which will be used inside the OTG form Or you can use it to transfer data from the old phone Along with it there is a ADAPTIVE FAST CHARGER by Samsung Which will fast the charger Also we have a USB-tec A-C cable And we get those-ear style earphones Which have a cable braided along with it Here are some extra tips So, that's all about all the box content Now let's see this phone The feeling of this phone is awesome This phone definitely looks very premium Let's remove the protection which is on the phone Samsung has put it on the back and the sides So, we'll see how bright this phone looks in this very interesting blue color. Now guys if I talk about the physical overview. Then you get a phone in front of you with a 6.2 inch Quad HD 18.5 in to 9 aspect ratio Super AMOLED screen. For which the Corning Gorilla Glass 5 is used for protection. And this Gorilla Glass 5 you will get the same back of the phone. The frame here comes with a matte finish which matches the color of the phone On one side you get the power lock unlock button on the other side you get the volume rocker along with the Bixby button On the phone you get a secondary microphone and sim tray where you can place 2 sim cards or a memory card up to 400GB Now you know what you will store in it Here you get a 3.5mm audio jack to 900GB memory card what you will store that you know The below of that phone we are getting 3.5 M Audio Jack means in 2018 you will getting working your standard earphones in this USB Type C port Primary microphone is first speaker because its second speaker is in upper earpiece so here we are getting dual speakers what a incredible point at backside we are getting dual camera set up which become first Samsung Galaxy S9 phone Dual Speakers and Dual Camera Setup The aperture of both these cameras is 12 MP You can change between f1.4 and it comes with a 2x optical-zoom option. So, you will be able to zoom in and click some amazing portrait shots. Around these cameras is a LED flash and Samsung's heart-rate monitor. What's interesting is that the fingerprint scanner is on the side below the camera, which is placed very conveniently and you can lock your phone by using this. And here, the you can lock the phone Here the phone's front camera is of 8MP Here you get the support Aperture of F1.7 Here if I provide to you some more details about the internals of the phone you will have to focus and have to see inside the phone you will see the battery of 3500 mAh and the processor of Samsung's Exynos 9810 on the side 6GB of's and the storage is of 64 GB So this is, Guys! The Main Physical Overview where you can get almost an entire screen. On the top side you get a lot of sensors. Outside of camera, there is Proximity sensor and Ambient Light sensor. Besides that, the iris scanning mechanism is also there, in between the display & the frame So, Let's Boot Our Phone. First boot you will need some time where, we get a lot of options to scan and it is hidden above in the middle of the frame Here if you put on a boot, then from the first boot the time will take a bit so that you can get different kinds of options to scan While setting up, in the center you will find the option to set up Samsung's security Here you will find a new option that is for intelligent scan Here you will be able to unlock both face unlock and iris scanning in fast Here in the settings, you will see that the phone is running on Android Oreo. You can see the camera setting here. You can scan your Face, use the predefined stickers, or use the predefined cartoons. Here, camera will be your tool and you'll create the interesting stickers and it's camera's UI which is also refind and you get a new super slow motion mode where you can record a 960 frames per second video but the length of the video is only 0.2 seconds but you can do the same stretch in the video and it looks amazing and apart from this you get many interesting options here The focus mode of the front camera The background will be blurred Apart from this, if you look here You will get to see some UI changes Pro mode is a feature The aperture They can also be set to Pro mode Otherwise, in automatic mode When the light is low , it will be set to f1.5 When sunny it will be will become f2.4 Now here we can test the dual speaker As you hear that the sound is very interesting Because it is very loud However, you can hear it through my microphone But I liked the speaker Here, my friends this phone this phone with IP68 Certification i.e. use it with water, dust and earth you can use this phone any place you also get the Bigspy Vision support so that you can work in an interesting way you can scan monuments, food and wines also live translation that is interesting feature and over here all the information about this phone this is Samsung Galaxy S9 Which is flagship phone for atleast first half till Note 9 doesn't come in market from Samsung now you will be saying about this video do tell me in the comments In fact, i can come a very interesting surprise for you where some phones not only reach to you but will also reach a few viewers which will be an amazing test and you will be formed quick You should take for this and show your love Friends that's all for the this new video Thanks for watching If your any suggestion then do comment below Don't forget to like, share
